description: Get one campaign and its matched creators. Ordinary public campaigns are free to read for any identified caller. A private campaign reads as not found for a caller outside the organization. Contract, creator posting date, campaign details declassifying date, and disclosure are present for members of the organization and may be null on open and summary reads. For members of the organization, people lists each person on the campaign once, with their profiles, their answer to the proposal, their funding (requested or funded), and their signed hire with the payout amount, paidAt (null while the payout is pending), and posts, each live post Starcovery recorded with its link, viewCount, and engagementCount (likes plus comments); people also lists a hire that matches no creator on the campaign, and is null for other callers. Hires and payouts are counted in people. For members of the organization, nextStep names the step the web app shows next, as list_campaigns does; it is null for other callers and once no step is left. currentSteps lists every step under way in campaign order in the same shape, because a step before nextStep can still wait, such as proposals Starcovery has not sent; currentSteps, not nextStep or status, tells whether a step is finished. It is null for other callers and empty once no step is left. Needs a credential.
name: get_campaign
title: Get campaign
